items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: I think I had Harold Moreno play piano with him at the time only on this job

ctx.x: And then played all the acts and everything else, you know? Mm-hmm. But he played good drums, and, and they had, uh, Kid René had a good drummer, too. I used to go and follow the bands all around, all these private parties, and every once in a while they let me sit in. When I first started to play it, I was playing pretty good then. Mm-hmm. That's when we formed the, uh, the Six Nola Jazz with Figgie Gerbick and Al Stratagas, and Eddie Powers on saxophone. And then we had Hal Maranto played piano first. Mm-hmm.…
